<thought>The previous search returned no templates when specifying both broken and formed groups. It’s possible that the template catalog only requires the broken functional group (sulfonamide) to match, without needing to specify the formed groups. I will search again using only the broken functional group “sulfonamides”.</thought>

<action_input>{

    "functional_groups_broken": ["sulfonamides"],
    "limit": 10
}
</action_input>
